Act as an independent, skeptical scientific convergence reviewer. I need a
decision about a deliberately narrow information-value claim, not enthusiasm
for a mechanism and not a code review. Please use the GitHub connector to
inspect https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code.git at the exact

docs/research/candidates/covariance_calibrated_information_clock/DIRECTION.md,
docs/research/candidates/covariance_calibrated_information_clock/CCIC_B1_SCIENCE_CARD.md,

Treat them as scientific background about evidence quotienting, lineage,
information timing, actions, and reduction risks. Do not reopen B1, inspect

prepared provider prompt as evidence.

The investment question is whether covariance orientation contains decision
information that remains unavailable to competent finite relational summaries
and a replication-safe invariant containing route. Calibration quality alone
does not count. Nor does beating scalar effective sample size, ordinary origin
counts, or a deliberately flat pair histogram. The desired action is one
scarce physical-time choice among commit and fixed-axis sensing or relay
channels under a common loss and common costs.

Please independently audit the following finite construction rather than
presuming either its positive or negative interpretation. There are eight
unique public evidence origins numbered zero through seven, all captured in
one public batch, with no ancestry or same-lineage relation. Their public
same-factor graph has edges 01, 03, 05, 06, 12, 24, 37, 47, 57, and 67. Vertices
zero and seven therefore have factor degree four and all others degree two.
Every edge owns an independent standard-normal physical calibration
disturbance which enters both endpoint rows with gain square-root two. Each row
also has independent private noise of variance one twentieth. Thus the row
noise covariance is generated by the physical factor model as one twentieth
times the identity plus twice degree-plus-adjacency; it is not introduced as
an oracle matrix.

The fixed terminal state is a two-vector with standard normal prior. Before
the state, disturbances, evidence, actions, or outcomes are drawn, a fair
public mounting coin chooses one of two loading assignments. In arm A,
vertices zero, one, four, and five load as (1,0), while vertices two, three,
six, and seven load as (0,-1). Arm B swaps those two loading types at every
origin. The task axes and the later physical sensing channels do not get
renamed when the mounting changes. Independent private noise gives both arms
full support, and no realized value or future action selects the arm.

The frozen low-order representation is intentionally strong. Its unary
measure includes the complete public row type, including signed loading,
factor degree, gain, quality, time, batch, lineage state, and factor size. Its
second-order measure is the complete empirical distribution over ordered row
pairs, stratified by both row types and every public same-factor, batch,
lineage, ancestry, direction, and lag relation, including all declared
degree-at-most-two loading and gain products. It includes the older
same-factor cross-label product statistic. Literal origin and factor names
carry no semantics.

In both arms there is one positive degree-four row, one negative degree-four
row, three positive degree-two rows, and three negative degree-two rows. Each
unordered same-factor endpoint type (+2,+4), (-2,-4), (+4,-2), (+2,-4), and
(+2,-2) occurs twice. All batch pair counts follow from equal unary counts;
lineage and ancestry counts are zero; lags and gains are common. The old
cross-label product is minus six in both arms. Please check whether these
facts really imply equality of the complete declared unary and pair
representations, including their ordered versions, or identify a missed legal
low-order coordinate.

Let J be H-transpose Sigma-inverse H and let P be (I+J)-inverse. The proposed
arm-A matrices are approximately

J_A = [[10.63959677, 0.43346170],
       [ 0.43346170, 1.04799841]]

and

P_A = [[ 0.08659618,-0.01832820],
       [-0.01832820, 0.49216082]].

Arm B is claimed to be the orthogonal conjugate under the signed axis swap, so
both arms have posterior spectrum approximately 0.08576958 and 0.49298742 and
equal scalar information trace about 11.68759517. Audit whether the loading
swap and fixed physical axes make this a genuine orientation difference
rather than a relabeling, and whether any scalar or spectral equality required
for the decision has been omitted.

The common actions are immediate commit, sense physical axis one, and sense
physical axis two. Each sensing action consumes one tick, creates one fresh
independent origin on its named fixed axis with noise variance 0.01, costs
0.05, and is followed by mandatory commit. Terminal loss is common squared
estimation error, normalized by the prior Bayes risk of two. The proposed
normalized risks are as follows. Commit costs 0.28937850 in either arm. In arm
A, sensing axis one costs 0.27382399 and sensing axis two costs 0.07286404. In
arm B those two sensing risks swap. Thus the unique action reverses, the
within-arm runner-up gap is 0.20095995, and a common policy measurable only
from the colliding scalar, spectrum, unary, and pair coordinates has balanced
risk 0.17334402 rather than the full-history oracle risk 0.07286404, a gap of
0.10047997. Check the risk formula, normalization, common-policy optimum, and
whether posterior means or public realized values create a hidden selection
or information issue. The predeclared material threshold for both action gap
and balanced oracle gap is 0.05.

Now examine the strongest proposed reduction. Define W as the number of
same-factor wedges j-i-k whose center i has positive loading and factor degree
two, and whose unordered neighbor types are one positive degree-four row and
one negative degree-two row. The claimed values are W equals one in arm A and
zero in arm B. A smoother signed contraction sums, over each center i and each
unordered pair of its same-factor neighbors j and k, the product of the center
sign, both neighbor signs, and both neighbor degrees. It is claimed to equal
positive twelve in arm A and negative twelve in arm B. The sign rule then
selects the same sensing action and risk as the covariance oracle.

Determine whether this wedge is a legitimate generic relational statistic or
a disguised task-aware answer. It must be invariant to row order, factor and
lineage names, within-type permutations, and literal-copy replication after
composite-key quotienting. It must use only public row types and same-factor
incidence, never a posterior, latent state, reward, outcome, regime bit, or
action value. Also determine whether a replication-safe generic containing
architecture that explicitly retains the unary and pair summaries can
actually express this distinction through an output-connected arity-three
motif channel or symmetric neighbor-then-global aggregation. Do not accept a
row-only Deep Set, a flat edge histogram, or an underpowered one-dimensional
message-passing baseline as competent. Conversely, do not count canonical
graph-to-covariance inversion or a posterior contraction as a generic scalar
shortcut merely because its output is one number.

Two other causal families were searched. In a fixed linear-Gaussian dynamic
system with independent time-labelled measurement noise, same-time
information updates commute, while the full directed time/channel pair
representation records the transition and update word. In clean disjoint
cross-time lineage blocks, directed-lag pair counts determine the correlated
likelihood contribution. Escaping those reductions with overlapping forks,
merges, diamonds, or cycles appears to introduce a public arity-three-or-higher
incidence motif or a canonical lineage DAG, analogous to the static wedge.
Try to produce a concrete counterexample in either family that preserves all
declared low-order coordinates and still has decision information unavailable
to a competent finite relational representation. If you cannot, explain the
reduction rather than treating absence of a counterexample as proof.

The proposed stopping judgment is that exact static evidence is sufficient to
answer conditional information value. Once a legal finite invariant exactly
matches the oracle on the only surviving host, a learned run on that host can
only test inductive bias, optimization, sample efficiency, numerical
stability, or calibration. Training cannot create information absent from the
exact comparison. Assess whether omitting an executable learned experiment is
therefore scientifically sound, or identify one specific answer-changing
observation that still requires execution. Any such observation must preserve
identical raw histories, known physical law, model knowledge, targets, action
head, updates, selection opportunity, and useful work for the covariance and
generic routes.

Give special attention to the strongest counterarguments. A low-order route
that receives raw values but not topology might probabilistically infer the
mounting arm; the optimal value-aware classifier has not been solved. A
generic motif learner may be expressive without learning the right rule under
a finite budget. Explicit covariance algebra may generalize more
compositionally across unseen factor graphs. Decide which of those points
changes the current information-value claim, which only lowers a scalar or
pair baseline claim, and which opens a distinct finite-work question. Also
look for a more damaging objection that has been missed.

Finally, give a bounded investment judgment among three possibilities. One is
continued specialized covariance-clock research because a genuine residual
decision-information advantage survives the strongest competent relational
route. A second is narrowing to higher-order relational lineage/set
reconstruction or to a separately scoped finite-work covariance-inductive-bias
question. A third is parking because neither specialized covariance nor the
narrowed object has a credible next discriminator. Do not infer lifecycle from
transport, repository history, or provider behavior. State the strongest
supporting fact, the strongest contradicting fact, the remaining alternative,
the exact claim ceiling, and the smallest next discriminator. If the finite
construction or reduction is defective, identify the first exact failed
premise and show what conclusion changes.
